items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution without authentication. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to run unauthorized commands and access sensitive information.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-92 (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-92, this high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability, affecting Adobe Commerce B2B and covered by APSB26-92, could enable a security-feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability
items.summary: Included in APSB26-92, this high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-92, this low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
